hypotheses.J0_autodiff_jacobian_matches_finite_diff: The tensor-metric relative error of the local Jacobian finite-difference control is at most 0.01.
hypotheses.J1_small_edit_linearization_is_accurate: The exact local Jacobian predicts 0.1x cyclic-edit effects with at least 0.90 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.J2_full_edit_is_more_nonlinear: Full-edit Jacobian fidelity is at least 0.10 below small-edit fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.J3_site_specific_rowspace_captures_small: Projecting 0.1x edits into the site-specific Jacobian row space reproduces at least 0.90 of the full finite effect on every corpus.
hypotheses.J4_site_specific_rowspace_remains_useful: The site-specific Jacobian row space reproduces at least 0.70 of the full cyclic-edit effect on every corpus.
hypotheses.J5_shared_sensitivity64_captures_small_e: The discovery-frozen rank-64 aggregate sensitivity subspace reproduces at least 0.70 of the 0.1x edit effect on every corpus.
hypotheses.J6_sensitivity64_beats_random64: At 0.1x scale, sensitivity rank 64 exceeds matched random rank 64 by at least 0.30 on every corpus.
hypotheses.J7_sensitivity16_beats_predictive16: At 0.1x scale, aggregate sensitivity rank 16 exceeds the predictive ridge span by at least 0.20 on every corpus.
hypotheses.J8_sensitivity128_is_useful_for_full_edi: Aggregate sensitivity rank 128 reproduces at least 0.50 of full cyclic-edit effects on every corpus.
hypotheses.J9_shared_sensitivity_subspace_transfers: Sensitivity-rank-64 small-edit fidelity differs by at most 0.15 across corpora.
hypotheses.J10_tensor_metric_is_positive: The context-to-operator Gram matrix is positive semidefinite to numerical tolerance.
